name: Eviscerating Strike (Ex)
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Advanced Rogue Talents

Benefit: A rogue with this ability can use his sneak attacks to disembowel an enemy. This attack deals no sneak attack damage, but instead deals 1d4+1 Constitution damage. The rogue may only use this rogue talent once per target.
